recaps.text: Watson met Stamford at a bar and learned about Sherlock Holmes. Stamford took Watson to a laboratory to meet the famous detective. Holmes showed Watson a new chemical discovery involving blood. The two men discussed their personal habits and agreed to meet the next day. Stamford then said goodbye as Watson and Holmes walked toward a hotel.

Watson and Holmes move into a new apartment on Baker Street. Watson notes Holmes's vast knowledge and his strange habits. Holmes reveals he is a consulting detective who can deduce personal details from observation. A man delivers a letter to the apartment and mentions his former military rank.
